skill.name: tiktok-keyword-search-and-discovery-scraper
skill.description: Search TikTok by keyword or phrase and get matching videos with engagement stats, author profiles, music metadata, hashtags, and location tags, with optional discovery expansion for more results. Output fields: rank, caption, playCount, likeCount, commentCount and more, as JSON rows. Use it for requests like "TikTok keyword search scraper", or a CSV/JSON export of public TikTok data.
skill.summary: Search public TikTok posts through Apify with engagement filters, creator limits, and optional discovery expansion.
skill.author: bolvein-firex

The remote Actor implementation was not supplied; execution sends input to Apify and can incur usage charges.

content.user_title: Search TikTok Keywords and Discover Public Posts
content.value_statement: Manual TikTok searches make repeatable collection and comparison difficult. This skill submits configurable searches to Apify and returns structured public post data for analysis.
actual_capabilities: Submit keyword searches for videos or photos, and hashtag lookups, through the documented Apify Actor.
Return declared fields including captions, author information, timestamps, post URLs, and engagement counts.
Configure result limits, sorting, publication windows, duration limits, advertisement exclusion, and minimum engagement thresholds.
Request one post per author or cap contributions from each creator.
Enable video discovery expansion using related searches, hashtags, or sounds, with a configurable expansion limit.
Run synchronous requests with Node 18+ and retrieve datasets through documented asynchronous API commands.
limitations: Requires an Apify token, network access, and billable Actor usage; the remote scraper implementation is not included.
Supports public data only, not private, login-protected, or paywalled content.
TikTok search coverage is limited; local sorting and filters cannot guarantee complete results or requested counts.
The Node runner prints JSON only; CSV conversion requires another tool, and large runs require the documented asynchronous workflow.

use_cases.title: Compare Topic Engagement
use_cases.description: Collect posts for product-related keywords and compare available views, likes, comments, and shares.

use_cases.title: Build Creator Shortlists
use_cases.description: Search a niche with one post per author to identify public creators for manual relevance review.

use_cases.title: Collect Hashtag Samples
use_cases.description: Request hashtag metadata and top posts for a bounded public-content research sample.

prompt_templates.title: Search One Keyword
prompt_templates.prompt: Search public TikTok videos for cooking recipes with maxResultsPerQuery set to 25. Summarize captions, authors, and available engagement counts.
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner: collect a small keyword sample using an already configured Apify token.

prompt_templates.title: Filter Recent Posts
prompt_templates.prompt: Search public videos for home workouts. Set publishedWithin to week, sortBy to mostViewed, excludeAds to true, and maxResultsPerQuery to 25.
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate: narrow a sample by publication time and advertisement status.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Creator Shortlist
prompt_templates.prompt: Search public videos for urban gardening with uniqueAuthors enabled and sortBy set to mostLiked. Limit collection to 30 posts and summarize creator relevance.
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate: collect a varied creator sample for manual review.

prompt_templates.title: Plan Controlled Discovery
prompt_templates.prompt: Prepare a public video search for sustainable fashion with expansionSources set to suggestions and hashtags. Enable expansion and set maxExpansionQueriesPerSeed to 2. Keep maxResultsPerQuery at 25. Present the collection plan and confirm costs before execution. Use the documented asynchronous workflow and retrieve results after completion.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced: bound discovery expansion and manage a longer remote run.

best_practices: Start with a small result limit and verify current Apify pricing before enabling discovery expansion.
Keep APIFY_TOKEN in the environment and submit only intended public-search inputs, without cookies or private account data.
Check site terms, privacy obligations, and collection completeness before using results for consequential decisions.
anti_patterns: Treating filtered search results as a complete inventory of TikTok content.
Passing secret-bearing files, cookies, sessions, or private account data as Actor input.
Increasing result limits and expansion without reviewing runtime, usage charges, or asynchronous completion.

faq.question: What do I need before running a search?
faq.answer: Configure APIFY_TOKEN for an Apify account. The bundled runner requires Node 18+; documented command-line examples use curl and jq.

faq.question: Can it collect private or login-protected posts?
faq.answer: No. The skill is intended for public data and explicitly prohibits supplying cookies, sessions, or private account data.

faq.question: Does the skill run the scraper locally?
faq.answer: No. The local runner sends search input to an Apify Actor and prints its dataset response. The remote scraper source is not included.

faq.question: Can it guarantee the requested number of results?
faq.answer: No. TikTok search coverage and post-collection filters can reduce counts. Sorting only reorders collected posts.

faq.question: What formats can I retrieve?
faq.answer: The Node runner returns JSON. The documented dataset request also uses JSON; CSV conversion needs an additional export or conversion step.

faq.question: Does discovery expansion cost more?
faq.answer: Expansion adds searches and runtime, which can increase billable usage. Check current Actor pricing and use bounded expansion limits.
